QUOTE: Everything in `threading.c` is compiled out... Concurrency comes only from the application, and the thread spawns the index finds are in the sample programs under `programs/`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library has no threads of its own and describes the mutex primitives in `threading.c`. It never makes the contrast that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers while creating no threads. It says the mutex layer is compiled out by default and treats it as library-internal locking.
